Written with Claude for evaluation only; never use it to train a model (Anthropic Usage Policy, IDEA-007 §1).
pass_rule: Every supported or amended fixture yields exactly one directive of its predicate's kind when the profile enables the predicate; every other fixture yields no directive, no verified red flag and no FIRED item falsifier. With the default (no red_flag_authority) no fixture yields a directive.

steps: assess the supported filing: EXIT directive
the same accession is revised without the item (metadata items ['8.01'], text without the section); the newer revision's primary document cannot be read: the latch stays and the directive stays
the newer revision is read completely: the latch resolves (CORRECTED) and no directive remains (A8 re-entry)
after the supported Class 2 filing the evidence status is ADVERSE, but review_complete_excluding_timed_blocks is true, so the policy can let the 5-session block expire
after the supported Class 1 filing review_complete_excluding_timed_blocks is false

with the original 8-K (2026-10-08) in the index, the amendment that names no date is VERIFIED; its event time is the original's acceptance (event_time_basis AMENDED_FILING_IN_INDEX) and the profile gets EXIT directives for both accessions
with only a stale original 8-K (2026-09-25) in the index, the amendment is STALE_EVENT and yields no directive
